description: Charles River Laboratories is a contract research organisation (CRO) and preclinical services company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. It provides drug discovery and safety assessment services — including in vivo studies using proprietary animal models — to biopharmaceutical companies, medical device makers, and government agencies. The company is also a leading supplier of research models (laboratory animals bred to specific genetic standards) and associated services to the scientific community. Its facilities are subject to routine FDA inspection, making it a frequent target of FOIA requests by investors seeking early intelligence on manufacturing compliance and regulatory standing.
